content.title: Definition of haemodynamic instability (acute high-risk pulmonary embolism)
content.summary: Definition which delineates acute high-risk pulmonary embolism: one of the following clinical manifestations at presentation.

manifestations.label: (2) Obstructive shock
details: Systolic BP < 90 mmHg or vasopressors required to achieve a BP ≥ 90 mmHg despite adequate filling status
End-organ hypoperfusion (altered mental status; cold, clammy skin; oliguria/anuria; increased serum lactate)

manifestations.label: (3) Persistent hypotension
details: Systolic BP < 90 mmHg or systolic BP drop ≥ 40 mmHg, lasting longer than 15 min and not caused by new-onset arrhythmia, hypovolaemia, or sepsis
